note: Refs for this project live in the Google Flow project, not on local disk. This manifest is the planning record of what each character/location needs. rules_audit check_reference_completeness will HARD-fail against local disk — that is expected and non-blocking for a Flow-driven project (same as batman-arkham-titan).

luna.face_card_brief: Adult woman, 25. Pale porcelain skin, long jet-black hair with deep-purple streaks, blunt straight bangs, smoky dark eye makeup, sharp winged eyeliner, black lipstick. Beautiful, confident, alluring goth. Neutral closed-mouth expression for the canonical card.

body_tiers.brief: Baseline. Normal adult height, hourglass figure, full curves, in the black corset minidress + fishnet sleeves + platform boots, fully laced/intact.
Max giantess scale. Same goth figure scaled enormous, curves fuller in proportion, dress strained to its limit with seam splits but fully covering, violet magic aura.

views.name: ecu-region
views.brief: Hand/forearm with violet magic sparks for the ignition beat.

turnaround_sheet.brief: User-supplied multi-angle turnaround: full-body turnaround (front/3q/side/REAR), face turnaround, expression strip (smirk+smug, angry+blush, sad+mockery, thoughtful), hand/boot detail crops. ATTACH for any non-front panel (L37) so back/profile views keep hair/outfit/proportion correct.

ethan.face_card_brief: Adult man, 25. Slim, soft features, short tidy brown hair, light stubble, round wire-frame glasses, flushed/nervous. Grey hoodie.

body_tiers.brief: Slim, slightly gangly, grey hoodie over tee, dark jeans, white sneakers. Never grows — always small.

turnaround_sheet.note: Sheet is titled 'ELIAS' in Flow; same character as our 'ethan' (name never spoken in-comic).
turnaround_sheet.brief: User-supplied turnaround: detailed skin close-up, neutral/expression/contemplative faces, FULL BODY turnaround front/profile/BACK view, detail close-ups, sneaker detail. ATTACH for any non-front panel (L37); REAR view used for p10 over-shoulder.

goth-loft.brief: Cozy top-floor goth loft: plum/charcoal walls, burgundy velvet tufted couch, Persian rug, tall arched window with sheer black curtains + city dusk, dozens of dripping candles, dead roses, occult bookshelf, pentagram tapestry, fairy lights, EXPOSED WOODEN CEILING BEAMS (height marker). DAZ3D Iray look: simple modeled furniture, soft GI, gentle candle bloom, shallow DOF. Build NEW off a web-sourced DAZ3D interior ref — do not copy.

magic-fx.brief: Violet/purple sparks + curling energy around Luna's hands and body. Identity color — never another hue.

build_order: 1. Source a DAZ3D interior reference from the web; save as goth-loft/_source.jpg with provenance.
2. Build the original goth-loft env-establish.png in Flow off that look.
3. Build Luna face-card, then body-tier1, then views (3q-full, ecu-face, ecu-region-hand, low-angle-front) off the face card + loft.
4. Build Luna body-tier6 + splash reinforcement (the max giantess scale anchor).
6. Then generate panels p01..p10 via the shotlist-driven-flow loop, view-aware chaining.
env_ref_note: goth-loft env established: 16:9 x4 batch, picked the balanced top-right render (couch+beams+arched windows+bookshelf+pentagram+candles). Lives in Flow project; attach via + asset picker to panels.
L37_note: Body-orientation variety mandatory (anti-AI). Turnaround sheets uploaded to Flow by user 2026-06-22; attach the relevant angle (rear/side) on p06(back), p07(3q-rear), p08(profile), p10(over-shoulder/back). Ethan + room are fixed real size; only Luna grows.
